Welcome Mat Get Enabled.label: Welcome Mat Get Enabled
Welcome Mat Get Enabled.desc: Return whether target welcome mat is enabled (true) or disabled (false)

Welcome Mat Set Enabled.label: Welcome Mat Set Enabled
Welcome Mat Set Enabled.desc: Set target welcome mat to be enabled (true) or disabled (false)

Xor.label: Xor
Xor.desc: Outputs True if exactly one of the inputs is True. Outputs False if all inputs are false, or more than one is True.
